name: failing-frame
purpose: Run the tests in a sandboxed copy and return the first failure: the exception, its message, every project frame with its code, and the exact line where the code under test raised it, with numbered lines around it, so you fix the right line.
examples: run the tests and show where the failing test breaks
find the line that raises the error in the traceback
locate the bug the test suite reports
which function crashes when the tests run

runner.description: auto: pytest when installed, else each test*.py file as a unittest module or a script; script runs one file as python3 FILE

target.description: the test file to run (default: every test*.py and *_test.py file)

include.description: more files the tests read, as glob patterns (e.g. data/**/*.bin), beyond the usual text and code files
